name: pin-lock-screen
title: PIN lock screen
description: A locked-session screen with a numeric keypad: avatar, dots that fill as digits land, a shake on a wrong PIN and a way out to sign out.
docs: user is { name, image?, detail? }; lockedAt (written as a clock time with locale and timeZone) and length (default 4) shape the screen. The keypad is a plain grid of buttons; the number row, Backspace and Escape work too, a held key does not repeat, and keyboard={false} turns the listener off. The dots are drawn only: a polite status says 3 of 4 digits entered, and the digits themselves are never written into the page. When the last digit lands onUnlock(pin) runs and resolves true (unlock) or false: the dots turn red and shake once (not under reduced motion), the PIN clears and Wrong PIN, 2 tries left is announced from attemptsLeft, which you count. With attemptsLeft at 0 the keys stop and Sign out is the way on. busy holds the keys while something of yours checks; onForgot and onSignOut add the two buttons. defaultWrong starts with the wrong-PIN message for a preview; titleAs and labels work as in the other auth cards. The screen fills the viewport (min-h-dvh), and the rhs-pin-shake keyframes are added to your CSS with it.
